decision: K51 (owner, 25 October 2026): a longer, branching technology tree; technologies that unlock equipment use the large layout
source: tools/content/data/technologies.json and technologies_warfare.json through modules/technologies.mjs (230 researchable technologies; the seven grant-only gates have no icon)
wiring: interface/zin_technologies.gfx names GFX_<technology>_medium for every row and points at gfx/interface/technologies/zin/<technology>.dds once that file exists (the ZIN frame until then); the art step only adds the DDS files.
style: Painted craft icons in the ZIN technology style: muted bronze, iron and parchment, one clear subject, no text, no modern objects. Equipment pictures match the equipment icons of the same item.

technologies.name: Couriers' Ciphers
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Recovered lost knowledge (a weathered scroll or broken relic motif): The couriers of the old resistance carried letters no governor could read.

technologies.name: Watch Fires
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: A pile of dry wood on every headland, tended night and day.

technologies.name: Scriptoria
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Scribes copy the records of the realm in warm rooms, and what one scholar learns no longer dies with him.

technologies.name: Libraries
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: The copied books are gathered, shelved and catalogued, and a scholar can find in an hour what once took a year.

technologies.name: Wax Seals
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: A letter closed with a signet and wax cannot be opened without showing it.

technologies.name: Horn Chains
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Horns on every hilltop answer one another from tower to tower, and a warning crosses a province before a rider could mount.

technologies.name: Universities
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Masters and students dwell together under a charter, and learning is taught, disputed and handed on in the open.

technologies.name: Cipher Scripts
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Scribes agree on secret alphabets, so that a stolen letter is only a page of nonsense.

technologies.name: Cipher Wheels
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Turning bronze wheels, a patient clerk can try a thousand keys against a stolen letter before supper.

technologies.name: Letter Counts
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Scholars count how often each letter appears in a secret page, and the commonest signs give themselves away.

technologies.name: Scholars' Conclaves
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: The learned of many halls meet each year to read their findings aloud, and each leaves with the others' work.

technologies.name: Far-Seeing Glass
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Ground lenses in brass tubes bring distant hulls close, and the watchers on the towers see a fleet hours before it lands.

technologies.name: Sealed Couriers
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Sworn riders carry sealed pouches by relays of fresh horses, and never read what they carry.

technologies.name: Reading Rooms
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: A locked chamber where trained readers work through every captured letter, and nothing that passes through it is forgotten.

technologies.name: The Great Library
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: One vast house holds every book the realm can gather.

technologies.name: Glass Towers
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Tall towers crowned with great lenses and signal lamps watch the whole horizon, and no coast is left unwatched.

technologies.name: Chanceries
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: One office seals the realm's letters and reads its neighbours', and the same clerks learn both crafts.

technologies.name: Royal Academies
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: The crown pays scholars to argue, measure and write in one house, and what they find is copied for every university.

technologies.name: Mirror Signals
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Polished mirrors flash news from tower to tower by day, faster than any rider.

technologies.name: The Refuge Granaries
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Recovered lost knowledge (a weathered scroll or broken relic motif): In the worst of the occupation hidden refuges kept seed, grain and the rules for sharing them.

technologies.name: Leaf-Craft
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: The elves coax living wood into the shapes they need, and the forest gives its timber without a tree falling.

technologies.name: Quarry-Songs

technologies.brief: Giants sing to the rock until it breaks along the line they want, and their quarries give stone in great clean blocks.

technologies.name: Hall-Delving
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: The holds cut their halls from the living rock, pillar by pillar, and know the stone as farmers know their soil.

technologies.name: Dressed Stone
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Masons learn to square and fit their blocks, so walls rise straight and halls stand longer.

technologies.name: Crop Rotation
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Grain, beans and fallow follow one another field by field, a way of farming that outlasted every hard winter of the occupation.

technologies.name: Forge-Pits
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Orcs and trolls dig their forges into the hillside and feed them day and night.

technologies.name: Vent-Forges
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: In the Ember Lands the hot vents of the earth feed forges that never go cold, and Essence rises with the fumes.

technologies.name: Deep Forges
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Forges far under the mountain burn hot and steady, out of the wind, and the holds' smiths never lack for heat.

technologies.name: Slaked Lime
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Burnt lime, slaked in pits and mixed with sand, binds a wall into one stone.

technologies.name: Pit Props
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Timber props hold the roof of a shaft, and miners follow the iron seam deeper than before.

technologies.name: Water-Wheels
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: A river turns the bellows and the grindstones, and the guild workshops make more with the same hands.

technologies.name: Slipways
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Greased slipways of stone and timber let a hull be laid down, built and launched without a single wasted tide.

technologies.name: Arch and Vault
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Masons roof wide halls and bridge deep gorges with a ring of wedged stones.

technologies.name: Quarry Wedges
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Iron wedges and wet wood split the rock along its grain.

technologies.name: Seed Reserves
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Sealed stone granaries hold seed against a bad year, so one failed harvest no longer empties the realm's provisions.

technologies.name: Trip-Hammers
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: A cam lifts a heavy hammer and lets it fall, over and over, while the smith turns the iron.

technologies.name: Wellspring Tapping
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: At the known wells, careful hands draw Essence into sealed jars.

technologies.name: Drainage Wheels
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Wheels of buckets lift water out of the deep workings, and the gold-bearing veins can be followed below the springs.

technologies.name: Standard Patterns
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Guilds agree on one pattern for each piece, so parts made in different workshops fit together and a changed order costs less.

technologies.name: Dry Docks
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: A basin with a sea-gate takes a ship in, is pumped dry, and leaves the hull open to the shipwright's tools.

technologies.name: Ley-Stone Channels
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Channels cut into the old stones guide the Essence to where it can be gathered, and little is lost on the way.

technologies.name: Great Halls
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: The guilds gather their forges and benches under one great roof, where a hundred smiths share a fire.

technologies.name: Village Forges
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: A forge in every village and a smith in every forge: the work is spread wide and can turn to any need.

technologies.name: Masons' Lodges
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Masons band into lodges that keep their secrets, teach their sons and travel to wherever a great work is begun.

technologies.name: Deep Shafts
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Shafts sink past the old workings into untouched rock, braced and aired by those who have learned how.

technologies.name: Irrigation Canals
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Canals carry the spring flood to dry fields.

technologies.name: Vaulted Halls
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Stone vaults roof the halls wider than timber ever could, with room for more benches and more fires.

technologies.name: Roadside Smithies
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Smithies beside the high roads mend wagons and tools on the spot, and the work never waits for a distant guild.

technologies.name: Many Hands
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Each worker learns one step of the making and does it all day.

technologies.name: Covered Yards
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Roofs over the shipways and the timber yards let the work go on through rain and snow.

technologies.name: Charcoal-Burners' Leagues
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: The woodland burners bind themselves into leagues and promise every forge its charcoal on a fixed day.

technologies.name: Phials and Vials
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Sealed phials of warded glass let Essence be kept and carried, and a realm can lay some by for hard times.

technologies.name: Treadwheel Cranes
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Men walking inside great wheels lift beams and anvils that no gang of porters could raise.

technologies.name: Travelling Smiths
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Smiths with a cart, an anvil and a charter go where the need is, and the realm's best hands are never idle.

technologies.name: Great Yards
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Whole shipyards are planned as one work, with ropewalks, sawpits and berths side by side.

technologies.name: Great Scaffolds
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Timber frames climb as high as the stone does, and the work no longer waits on the weather.

technologies.name: Pattern Books
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Every pattern is drawn and kept in a book, so a workshop can turn from one making to another without losing a week.

technologies.name: Masters' Benches
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: The best hands keep their benches and teach whoever sits beside them, and a new workshop reaches full skill sooner.

technologies.name: Assayers' Rolls
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item
technologies.brief: Assayers keep rolls of every seam they have tested, so no miner digs where the rock has already been proved poor.

technologies.name: Crown Foundries
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item

technologies.name: Steading Foundries
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item

technologies.name: Deep Wells
technologies.size: 64 x 64, transparent corners, drawn in the 72 x 72 small item

technologies.name: Parish Granaries

technologies.name: Guild Charters
